-- Violent | screenshot replica, 1337 × 794.
-- All art is static. Nothing reads or changes the live world, players, or camera.
-- Paste the complete file into a client Luau context. No asset IDs or HTTP calls.

local W, H = 1337, 794
local RGB = Color3.fromRGB
local WHITE = RGB(250, 250, 250)
local INK = RGB(9, 8, 9)
local PINK = RGB(255, 15, 143)
local SELECTED = RGB(255, 85, 176)
local BODY_FONT = Enum.Font.Gotham
local DISPLAY_FONT = Enum.Font.Arcade

local function create(class, parent, properties)
    local object = Instance.new(class)
    for key, value in pairs(properties) do object[key] = value end
    object.Parent = parent
    return object
end

local function rect(parent, name, x, y, w, h, color, alpha)
    return create("Frame", parent, {
        Name = name, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h),
        BackgroundColor3 = color or INK, BackgroundTransparency = alpha or (color and 0 or 1),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    })
end

local function label(parent, name, text, x, y, w, h, size, options)
    options = options or {}
    return create("TextLabel", parent, {
        Name = name, Text = text, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = options.font or BODY_FONT,
        TextSize = size, TextColor3 = options.color or WHITE,
        TextStrokeTransparency = options.outline and 0 or 1,
        TextXAlignment = options.align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
    })
end

local function stroke(parent, color, thickness)
    return create("UIStroke", parent, { Color = color, Thickness = thickness, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
end

local function gradient(parent, angle, stops)
    local points = {}
    for i, item in ipairs(stops) do points[i] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(item[1], item[2]) end
    create("UIGradient", parent, { Color = ColorSequence.new(points), Rotation = angle })
end

local function line(parent, name, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width, alpha)
    local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
    local frame = rect(parent, name, (x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2, math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy), width, color, alpha)
    frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    frame.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
    return frame
end

local function rounded(parent, name, x, y, w, h, color, radius, alpha)
    local f = rect(parent, name, x, y, w, h, color, alpha)
    create("UICorner", f, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) })
    return f
end

local function chain(parent, name, points, width, color)
    for i = 1, #points - 2, 2 do
        line(parent, name, points[i], points[i+1], points[i+2], points[i+3], color, width)
    end
end

-- The controls are deliberately inert even when clicked or activated by gamepad.
local function noOp() end
local function target(parent, name, x, y, w, h)
    local button = create("TextButton", parent, {
        Name = name, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "", BorderSizePixel = 0,
        AutoButtonColor = false, Selectable = false,
    })
    button.Activated:Connect(noOp)
    return button
end

local function healthRail(parent, x, y, height, topGap)
    rect(parent, "Health rail", x, y, 5, height, RGB(18, 10, 15))
    local fill = rect(parent, "Health gradient", x+1, y+topGap, 2, height-topGap, WHITE)
    gradient(fill, 90, {{0, RGB(87,250,28)}, {0.42, RGB(213,236,19)}, {0.76, RGB(255,113,25)}, {1, RGB(252,34,47)}})
end

local function demoBox(parent, x, y, w, h, gap)
    local box = rect(parent, "Static demonstration box", x, y, w, h)
    for i = 1, 10 do
        local spread = i*2
        local glow = rect(box, "Magenta glow", -spread, -spread, w+2*spread, h+2*spread)
        stroke(glow, RGB(193, 12, 209), 4).Transparency = 0.91 + i*0.007
    end
    local tint = rect(box, "Violet wash", 0, 0, w, h, WHITE, 0.72)
    gradient(tint, 90, {{0, RGB(64,33,90)}, {1, RGB(145,6,206)}})
    stroke(tint, RGB(21, 9, 22), 3)
    stroke(rect(box, "Inset border", 3, 3, w-6, h-6), RGB(153, 61, 156), 1).Transparency = 0.6
    healthRail(box, -7, -1, h+2, gap)
    return box
end

local function logo(parent, text, x, y, w, h, size, centered)
    return label(parent, text, text, x, y, w, h, size, {
        font = DISPLAY_FONT, outline = true, align = centered and Enum.TextXAlignment.Center or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    })
end

local rows = {
    {"Enable Skeleton", 134, "check"},
    {"Skeleton Thickness", 160, "value", "1"},
    {"Skeleton Color", 187, "color", RGB(255,255,255)},
    {"Hightlight ESP", 241, "check"},
    {"Hightlight Fill", 268, "check"},
    {"Hightlight Outline", 295, "check"},
    {"Hightlight Fill Color", 322, "color", RGB(255,0,234)},
    {"Hightlight Outline Color", 349, "color", PINK, true},
    {"Show Health Bar", 403, "check"},
    {"Healt Bar Size", 430, "value", "2.5"},
}

local function buildMenu(parent)
    local panel = rect(parent, "Violent settings", 27, 28, 308, 513, RGB(5,6,7), 0.27)
    local header = rect(panel, "Pink title banner", 0, 0, 308, 77, PINK)
    logo(header, "VIOLENT", 0, 0, 308, 77, 46, true)
    local category = rect(panel, "Category bar", 0, 77, 308, 29, RGB(3,3,3))
    label(category, "Category", "VISUALS / HUD", 8, 0, 200, 29, 14)
    label(category, "Position counter", "29/51", 238, 0, 62, 29, 14, {align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right})
    for _, spec in ipairs(rows) do
        local name, absoluteY, kind, value, selected = table.unpack(spec)
        local row = rect(panel, name, 0, absoluteY-28, 308, 25, selected and SELECTED or nil)
        label(row, "Caption", name, 8, 0, 260, 24, 14, {color = selected and INK or WHITE})
        if kind == "check" then
            local box = rect(row, "Checked box", 282, 3, 18, 17)
            stroke(box, WHITE, 1.8)
            chain(box, "Check mark", {3,9, 7,13, 14,5}, 1.9, WHITE)
        elseif kind == "color" then
            local swatch = rect(row, "Color swatch", 278, 3, 26, 18, value)
            stroke(swatch, RGB(59, 44, 56), 0.8).Transparency = 0.44
        else
            label(row, "Value", value, 244, 0, 57, 24, 14, {align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right})
        end
    end
    for _, section in ipairs({{"HIGHLIGHTS",214,90}, {"HEALTH BAR",376,94}, {"TEXT",457,41}}) do
        local name, y, width = table.unpack(section)
        rect(panel, name .. " underline", (308-width)/2, y-28+21, width, 2, RGB(206,44,137), 0.32)
        logo(panel, name, 0, y-28, 308, 26, 20, true)
    end
    local footer = rect(panel, "Release and selector", 0, 460, 308, 29, RGB(3,3,3), 0.22)
    label(footer, "Release", "Release, v1.4", 9, 0, 126, 27, 14, {font = Enum.Font.SourceSansItalic})
    chain(footer, "Up arrow", {147,11, 152,6, 157,11}, 2.1, WHITE)
    chain(footer, "Down arrow", {147,16, 152,21, 157,16}, 2.1, WHITE)
    rect(panel, "Text section right indicator", 281, 459, 20, 1, WHITE)
    rect(panel, "Status separator", 0, 490, 308, 3, RGB(184, 53, 126), 0.18)
    local status = rect(panel, "Status", 0, 493, 308, 20, RGB(3,3,3), 0.1)
    label(status, "Status label", "Set color to: Hightlight Outline Color", 8, 0, 294, 20, 11)
end

local function buildPreview(parent)
    local panel = rect(parent, "ESP preview panel", 353, 27, 276, 316, RGB(1, 4, 7), 0.23)
    rect(panel, "Fuchsia top border", 0, 0, 276, 5, RGB(223, 18, 124))
    logo(panel, "ESP PREVIEW", 13, 10, 252, 30, 24)
    for i, text in ipairs({"Roblox doesnt support highlights or selection boxes", "in viewportframes so previews arent possible on", "those options."}) do
        label(panel, "Preview note " .. i, text, 13, 40+(i-1)*12, 259, 13, 10)
    end
    local rig = demoBox(panel, 77, 103, 121, 195, 40)
    rounded(rig, "Side-profile torso", 40, 53, 37, 75, RGB(143,111,157), 9, 0.19)
    rounded(rig, "Side-profile head", 44, 21, 35, 42, RGB(158,140,163), 9, 0.17)
    rounded(rig, "Side-profile arm", 37, 62, 13, 69, RGB(141,109,158), 4, 0.2)
    rounded(rig, "Side-profile legs", 44, 116, 33, 67, RGB(134,89,162), 4, 0.24)
    chain(rig, "Static white bones", {60,39, 60,68, 57,81, 56,113, 59,131, 59,172}, 1, WHITE)
    chain(rig, "Static white bones", {62,67, 62,104, 63,121, 61,155}, 1, WHITE)
end

-- Native fallback artwork: fixed screen-space composition; never attaches to the world.
local function buildScene(parent)
    local sky = rect(parent, "Sky", 0, 0, W, 300, WHITE)
    gradient(sky, 90, {{0, RGB(101,183,224)}, {1, RGB(167,213,222)}})
    rounded(sky, "High cloud", 920, 8, 68, 15, RGB(203,227,227), 7, 0.7)
    rounded(sky, "Low cloud", 1109, 150, 160, 10, RGB(187,222,230), 5, 0.78)
    local ground = rect(parent, "Baseplate", 0, 289, W, 505, WHITE)
    gradient(ground, 90, {{0, RGB(121,119,121)}, {1, RGB(99,97,98)}})
    for r = 0, 28 do
        local t = r/28
        local y = 2 + 490 * t^2.65
        local pitch = 11 + 36*t^1.8
        for c = -40, 40 do
            local x = 719 + c*pitch + (r%2)*pitch*0.45
            if x > 9 and x < W-9 then
                local stud = rect(ground, "Stud", x, y, 1.6 + 14*t^2, 0.7 + 7.7*t^2, RGB(129,126,129), 0.24)
                stud.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                stud.Rotation = -10 + (x-720)/37
                stroke(stud, RGB(50,47,49), 0.5 + 0.6*t).Transparency = 0.37
            end
        end
    end
    local function shadow(x, y, w)
        rounded(parent, "Soft shadow", x, y, w, 19, RGB(37,32,36), 12, 0.49).Rotation = -16
    end
    shadow(658,623,112)
    shadow(892,550,98)
    local main = demoBox(parent, 665, 416, 132, 212, 0)
    label(parent, "Static name tag", "femboy", 665, 390, 124, 21, 14, {align = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center})
    local function limb(host, name, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width)
        local part = line(host, name, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width)
        create("UICorner", part, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)})
    end
    local plum, orchid = RGB(143,37,166), RGB(206,61,188)
    rounded(main, "Pink avatar torso", 38, 58, 49, 65, plum, 10, 0.12)
    rounded(main, "Pink avatar head", 42, 25, 40, 36, RGB(220,85,187), 9, 0.07)
    rounded(main, "Magenta hair", 34, 15, 56, 32, RGB(234,54,171), 14, 0.1)
    rounded(main, "Tinted glasses", 42, 42, 43, 10, RGB(101,31,136), 4, 0.12)
    limb(main, "Left arm", 38,70, 29,134, orchid, 15)
    limb(main, "Right upper arm", 84,68, 105,87, orchid, 14)
    limb(main, "Right lower arm", 104,87, 92,110, orchid, 14)
    limb(main, "Left leg", 53,114, 53,184, plum, 18)
    limb(main, "Right leg", 67,114, 90,181, plum, 17)
    rounded(main, "Pink left shoe", 47, 181, 21, 19, orchid, 7)
    rounded(main, "Pink right shoe", 83, 173, 16, 18, orchid, 7)
    for _, path in ipairs({{63,45,65,89,66,114}, {31,128,32,96,35,83,65,89,94,73,101,86,95,98}, {55,183,59,140,66,114,78,138,89,173}}) do
        chain(main, "Static white bones", path, 1, WHITE)
    end
    line(parent, "Static tracer from sample", 732, 629, 850, 794, WHITE, 1, 0.1)
    line(parent, "Cropped static tracer", 0, 736, 249, 794, WHITE, 1, 0.12)
    local other = rect(parent, "Bystander cutout", 903, 397, 95, 161)
    local jacket, skin, pants = RGB(24,24,27), RGB(171,161,152), RGB(31,30,30)
    rounded(other, "Head", 28, 16, 31, 33, skin, 7)
    for n = 0, 4 do
        rounded(other, "Bacon hair curl", 22+n*7, 5+(n%2)*3, 13, 26, n%2==0 and RGB(134,81,35) or RGB(95,50,22), 6).Rotation = -32+n*13
    end
    rect(other, "Eye", 38, 31, 2, 4, INK)
    rect(other, "Eye", 48, 30, 2, 4, INK)
    chain(other, "Smile", {39,39, 43,42, 48,40}, 1, INK)
    rect(other, "Jacket", 22, 49, 46, 57, jacket)
    rect(other, "Blue shirt", 34, 51, 21, 52, RGB(1,92,143))
    limb(other, "Left sleeve", 21,55, 11,87, jacket, 18)
    limb(other, "Right sleeve", 70,54, 83,83, jacket, 19)
    limb(other, "Left hand", 10,89, 11,104, skin, 14)
    limb(other, "Right hand", 83,84, 88,102, skin, 14)
    limb(other, "Left leg", 35,105, 30,146, pants, 19)
    limb(other, "Right leg", 54,105, 64,145, pants, 20)
    rounded(other, "Left shoe", 18, 142, 20, 13, WHITE, 6)
    rounded(other, "Right shoe", 52, 142, 22, 13, WHITE, 6)
end

-- The bundled pixel layer preserves the original 1337×794 artwork, including the
-- two static avatars and HUD drawings. It uses two tiles to stay below 1024 px.
-- If EditableImage or its device budget is unavailable, native artwork is used.
local function mountReference(canvas, tiles)
    local holder = rect(canvas, "Bundled screenshot artwork", 0, 0, W, H)
    holder.Visible = false
    local images = {}
    local ok = pcall(function()
        local assets = game:GetService("AssetService")
        local encoding = game:GetService("EncodingService")
        for _, tile in ipairs(tiles) do
            local size = Vector2.new(tile.w, H)
            local image = assert(assets:CreateEditableImage({Size = size}), "No editable image budget")
            table.insert(images, image)
            local encoded = buffer.fromstring(table.concat(tile.data))
            local compressed = encoding:Base64Decode(encoded)
            local pixels = encoding:DecompressBuffer(compressed, Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
            assert(buffer.len(pixels) == tile.w * H * 4, "Invalid embedded art length")
            image:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.new(0, 0), size, pixels)
            create("ImageLabel", holder, {
                Name = "Static artwork tile", BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(tile.x, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(tile.w, H),
                ImageContent = Content.fromObject(image), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch,
            })
        end
    end)
    local function release()
        for _, image in ipairs(images) do image:Destroy() end
        table.clear(images)
    end
    if not ok then
        holder:Destroy()
        release()
        return false
    end
    canvas.Destroying:Connect(release)
    holder.Visible = true
    return true
end

local function mount(tiles)
    local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
    if not runService:IsClient() then return end
    if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
    local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local root = player and (player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10))
    if not root or not root:IsA("PlayerGui") then
        warn("Violent replica: local PlayerGui is not available.")
        return
    end
    local screenName = "ViolentScreenshotReplica"
    local old = root:FindFirstChild(screenName)
    if old and old:IsA("ScreenGui") and old:GetAttribute("ViolentReplicaOwned") == true then old:Destroy() end
    local screen = create("ScreenGui", nil, {
        Name = screenName, ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 40,
        ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
    })
    screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    screen.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.None
    screen.ClipToDeviceSafeArea = false
    screen:SetAttribute("ViolentReplicaOwned", true)
    local viewport = rect(screen, "Viewport", 0, 0, 0, 0, RGB(9,10,12))
    viewport.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    local canvas = rect(viewport, "Reference canvas", 0, 0, W, H)
    canvas.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    canvas.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    canvas.ClipsDescendants = true
    local scale = create("UIScale", canvas, {Scale = 1})
    local function fit()
        local size = viewport.AbsoluteSize
        if size.X > 0 and size.Y > 0 then scale.Scale = math.min(size.X/W, size.Y/H) end
    end
    viewport:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(fit)
    local hasReference = mountReference(canvas, tiles)
    local native = rect(canvas, "Native visual components", 0, 0, W, H)
    if not hasReference then buildScene(native) end
    buildMenu(native)
    buildPreview(native)
    native.Visible = not hasReference
    local controls = rect(canvas, "Inert control targets", 0, 0, W, H)
    controls.ZIndex = 2
    for _, spec in ipairs(rows) do target(controls, spec[1], 27, spec[2], 308, 25) end
    target(controls, "Up selector", 164, 488, 29, 14)
    target(controls, "Down selector", 164, 502, 29, 15)
    screen.Parent = root
    fit()
end
